column1: Questions
Are consumers informed about what data is processed by your organisation at every data collection checkpoint? Is the information easily accessible?

Does your privacy notice contain the following information:
i) Categories of personal information (including sensitive personal information) collected
ii) Purpose of collecting the information
iii) Whether the information is sold or not?
iv) How long is the information retained?
v) The rights of the consumers under the CPRA and how can they exercise these rights?
Is your privacy policy updated atleast once in 12 months? How do you communicate the change to the consumers?
Do you sell consumer personal information? If yes, do you notify the consumers about it?
If you sell personal information or use sensitive personal information, do you have a page on your website titled 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information'
If you collect sensitive personal information, do you have a page titled 'Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information' on your website?
How are consumers made aware about their rights?
How can consumers submit requests to exercise their rights?
Do you have at least 2 desginated methods through which consumers can submit their requests?
How can consumers modify their data if it is inaccurate?
What is your organisation's process to delete data if requested by a consumer?
Do you commit to keep data deletion Turnaround Time(TAT) not more than 45 days (in line with the CPRA)?

Do you have the infrastructure/process to single out an individual and give out the information like what data categories have been collected, what is the source of the information, with which 3rd parties have the data been shared/sold to, etc?
If you are a service provider/contractor to a business, how do you communicate the consumer requests to the businesses?
Does your organisation engage contractors/service providers?
If yes, whata data is shared with them? Is the information disclosed in your privacy notice?
If you engage a new contractor/service provider, how are the consumers made aware about the change?
How do you ensure that your contractor/service providers are atleast at the same level of security and privacy as yours?
Do you have legal agreements/data processing addendum with all your contractors/service providers?

Do legal agreements specify the following:
i) That the personal information is sold or disclosed by the business only for limited and specified purposes.
ii) Obligates the third party, service provider, or contractor to comply with applicable obligations under California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and obligates those persons to provide the same level of privacy protection as is required by the CPRA.
iii) Requires the third party, service provider, or contractor to notify the business if it makes a determination that it can no longer meet its obligations under the CPRA.
If you receive a data deletion/modification request, how do you ensure the deletion of the data from your contractors/service providers?

If you are a contractor/service provider and engage any other contractor/service provider, how many days in advance do you notify the businesses about the change? Are businesses given an option to object to it?
How do you monitor the compliance of your contractors/service providers?
What data is processed by your organisation?
Do you maintain a records of processing activities including the activities involving sharing, disclosing, selling data to 3rd parties?
Do you process sensitive personal information? If yes, what is the process for the users to exercise their right of limiting the use of sensitive personal information?
Is the data collected used for any other purposes other than the original purposes that were communicated to the consumer?
If yes to the above question, are consumers made aware of the new purposes before the data is processed? How?
Do you maintain records of deletion of the personal information? If yes, for how long?
What are data security controls implemented by your organisation?
Do you encrypt all the data including credentials and financial data? How are they encrypted and stored?
Describe how you ensure consumers' personal information is protected from unauthorized modification, use, or disclosure.
How often do you test the efficiency of your security measures? Does it happen in house or through an external vendor?
In case of a security breach, how do you inform the affected consumers?
Do you perform cybersecurity audits through an independent auditor at least annually?

In case you process sensitive personal information, do you regularly submit risk assessments to the California Privacy Protection Agency to keep them informed of your personal data processing practices?
